main_body: A dark stone column shaft with three gold ring ornaments, a wider grey cap at the top and a matching grey base block at the bottom.
top_band: x=8: row 8 is the outline (L=24). Rows 9-11 are grey L=115, and row 12 is a lighter edge line L=138. Rows 13-14 are a dark underside L=69, then the dark shaft begins.
evidence: The cap is a wider plate with slightly rounded corners, but its light top-face rows (9-11) number only 3, below the 4-row minimum for a column cap. The row-12 highlight is a front-edge line, not part of the top face. The cap then drops straight into a dark underside, which matches the guide's red 'flat band cap'. The bottom block is built the same way. The shaft is a flat front-on strip with the gold rings painted on it. No ellipse or plate top is visible from above.

style.evidence: The candidate has only 7 distinct colours and a median of 7 per tile, against 38-40 colours and 17-20 per tile in the references. 100% of its dark edge pixels are neutral, so the outline is a near-black sticker line, while the references are tinted (1% and 33% neutral). The shaft is a near-black slab with only a thin lighter strip on the left. The cap has about 3 grey steps. There is no grain or texture. The 5x5 flat-fill figure is 0%, but only because the shaft is narrow; it still reads as flat and shallow next to the references.
